name: paayn (push ups are all you need)

mentions.name: paayn (push ups are all you need)
mentions.description: A deliberately minimalistic PWA that counts exercise reps using a mobile phone's sensors (camera, lux levels, and/or accelerometer). It supports push ups, squats, and sit ups, and guests can sign in to try it out.
mentions.problem: The author wanted to continue tracking exercise reps after attempting a charity push up challenge in February.
mentions.source_excerpt:
After attempting a charity push up challenge in Feb I wanted to contiune with a similar app to track reps, so I build paayn (push ups are all you need).

It's deliberately minimalistic PWA that uses you mobile's sensors (camera, using lux levels and/or acclerometer) to count reps.
